observed_text:
For periodic maintenance preparation, the applicable specified procedures should cover three domains: (1) inspection/monitoring of the bearing and its installation condition (e.g., condition checks, clearance, fit, and visual/functional checks as the procedure defines); (2) lubrication management (lubricant type/specification, quantity, replenishment/replacement method, and cleanliness handling); and (3) documentation/record-keeping and scheduling control (recording results, tracking condition trends, and defining who authorizes actions). This is a generic educational framing, not a model-specific procedure. Regarding the interval: this material cannot choose the actual maintenance interval. The supplied context contains no model-specific thresholds, no actual device records, no lubricant identity/specification/batch, no sampling quantity, and no aviation/reuse authorization. The 'normal' class and the 'no fault cause assumed' scenario are caller-assigned teaching assumptions, not observations or classifier inferences, so they cannot be used to set or justify an interval. The actual interval must come from the applicable specified procedure and the equipment's actual operating and condition data, which are not supplied here.
Scope is registered generic bearing education only; no model-specific or aviation/reuse authorization is provided.
The 'normal' predicted class and 'no fault cause assumed' scenario are independently specified teaching assumptions, not observations or classifier inferences.
No actual device records, lubricant container identity/specification/batch, sampling quantity, or model-specific thresholds were supplied, so no actual maintenance interval can be selected.
The three-domain framing is general model knowledge, not a quoted manufacturer procedure or a verified reading of SRC-K01-02.
